summary_en: 40,000 shares (0.7% S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-20 at ¥606/share ceiling; total outlay ¥24.24M; execution limited to single trading session open-market block placement.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Treasury Stock Purchase via Off-Session Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-19, the board of TOAMI Corporation resolved to acquire up to 40,000 shares of its own common stock in response to changing business conditions and to pursue flexible capital management. The acquisition will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 (off-session trading) on 2026-08-20 at the market open (08:45 JST), using the closing price of 2026-08-19 (¥606/share) as the ceiling. Total outlay is capped at ¥24.24M. The purchase order is valid only for that single trading session; partial or no execution is possible depending on market conditions. Treasury holdings as of 2026-08-19 were 717,835 shares; shares outstanding (excluding treasury) numbered 5,682,165, making the 40,000-share program 0.7% of the latter. Results will be announced after market close on 2026-08-20.
